cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That tape I added is the only thing holding the curtain for the finale. Leave the edge alone, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said it looked untidy. I was going to peel it off before the bows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Peeling isn't tidying if the curtain comes down. Keep your hands clear until the last dancer exits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll include the stage crew in the thanks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Name the person whose tape you asked to remove. Put it before 'and the rest of the crew', please; that untidy strip is what's letting you give thanks in front of a curtain.
